caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a head covering or veil, primarily illustrated using black ink lines on a beige background. The main form is dome-shaped and shaded with crosshatching, indicating volume and texture. Across the surface of this form are numerous small circular clusters, each formed by three or four black outlined loops with a yellow dot in the center, distributed evenly. From the lower edges and partially covering the form, multiple strings of circles dangle downward in vertical lines, suggesting beaded or decorative strands. The overall composition focuses on the detailed depiction of the head covering and its embellishments, with no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Net Cap
